Core mandate The CEO will be accountable for four priorities: Build a repeatable direct sales engine focused on lighthouse customers in data centers, telecom, HPC and AI infrastructure. Build an indirect go-to-market engine through selected partners, including technology partners, OEMs, distributors, integrators and ecosystem alliances. Convert technical differentiation and platform value into contracted revenue, customer references and scalable commercial proof points. Raise the institutional capital required to support scale-up and international expansion. Key responsibilities Define and execute the company's European go-to-market strategy across both direct and indirect channels. Personally lead strategic sales opportunities with priority end customers and convert pilots or early deployments into commercial rollouts. Build and manage a high-quality pipeline, sales process, pricing logic, forecasting discipline and customer value proposition. Design and scale the partner model, including partner recruitment, enablement, joint account planning, co-selling, deal registration, channel governance and performance management. Turn key strategic partners into measurable pipeline, partner-sourced revenue and repeatable channel economics. Lead the next funding round end to end, including equity story, financial model, investor outreach, diligence and close. Coordinate the company day to day across sales, technical, product, operations and finance, ensuring clear priorities, alignment and pace of execution. Build and maintain strong relationships with key production partners and ensure manufacturing readiness supports commercial growth. Align product, operations, finance and commercial priorities around a focused 24-month growth plan. Work closely with the CTO Founder to sharpen the product vision, strengthen the platform roadmap and accelerate the next stage of product and market development. Recruit and lead a compact, high-performance leadership team suited to an early-commercial growth company. Act as the company's primary external representative with customers, partners, investors and the Board. Candidate profile The ideal candidate brings: Proven success in scaling a B2B technology business in data-center infrastructure, energy technology, telecom, digital infrastructure, industrial technology or a closely related field. A strong track record in direct enterprise sales involving long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals. Meaningful experience building indirect go-to-market channels and partner-led revenue models. Demonstrated fundraising experience with venture, growth, strategic or other institutional investors. Financial and operational command, including P&L, cash runway, prioritization and Board reporting. Sufficient technical fluency to engage credibly with customers, engineers, production partners and investors on data-center energy and power-management topics. The ability to operate effectively in an early-stage, resource-constrained and high-accountability environment. Leadership characteristics The successful candidate is expected to be: Commercially driven and externally focused. Credible with investors and senior enterprise buyers. Comfortable operating hands-on rather than through layers. Structured, data-led and execution oriented. Able to balance urgency with sound judgment. Effective in founder, Board and partner environments. Success measures Success in the role will be defined by: Growth in qualified pipeline, bookings and revenue. Conversion of lighthouse accounts into reference customers and repeat deployments. Development of a productive indirect route to market, with partner-sourced opportunities and bookings becoming a meaningful share of growth. Closure of the next funding round on terms that support scale. Strong alignment between commercial promises, product readiness and operational delivery. Global data-center electricity consumption is expected to more than double by 2030, increasing the relevance of technologies that improve energy efficiency and infrastructure utilization. Its patented Intelligent PDU platform is built around measurable operational and energy outcomes, with a software-led value proposition supported by critical rack-level control and infrastructure intelligence. This role offers the opportunity to shape a European technology company with real relevance to the AI era, power-constrained infrastructure growth and the future of energy-efficient data-center operations. It is not a stewardship role; it is a build-and-scale mandate.
